subject.title: Anthropic replay fails with "Invalid signature in thinking block" for thinking-enabled sessions after tool loops (no compaction)

question: Should the linked native Anthropic replay fix also handle Fable5 completed-turn stale signatures, or should that recovery be split to a separate wrapper/recovery path?
rationale: The issue now has production Fable5 evidence, but the open closing PR intentionally preserves Fable5 full replay, so the remaining scope depends on maintainer replay-policy intent.

options.title: Require Fable5 coverage before closure
options.body: Keep this issue open until the linked PR or a linked follow-up proves completed-prior Fable5 stale thinking no longer bricks sessions.

options.title: Accept non-Fable5 scope
options.body: Land the linked PR for non-Fable5 and explicitly track Fable5 invalid-signature recovery in a separate issue if maintainers want that split.

options.title: Choose a broader sanitizer
options.body: Supersede the linked PR only if a broader sanitizer preserves active tool-use contracts and has provider proof.

recommendation.title: Require Fable5 coverage before closure
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the linked PR or a linked follow-up proves completed-prior Fable5 stale thinking no longer bricks sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Anthropic provider/runtime history and previous review routing point to steipete as the best owner for the replay-policy choice.
